name: coding-agent-skills
description: Verified, portable engineering skills for agent-ready repositories, with quality contracts, security checks, eval fixtures, recipes, and optional coding-agent delegation adapters.
shortDescription: Verified engineering skills for agent-ready repositories.
longDescription: A curated cross-agent engineering skillpack built on portable SKILL.md packages. It adds repository discovery, planning, CI triage, risk assessment, review, security, testing, migrations, releases, documentation synchronization, composition recipes, quality contracts, security scanning, and behavioral-evaluation fixtures. Vendor-specific CLI skills remain optional delegation adapters rather than the canonical product model.
defaultPrompt: Choose the smallest relevant engineering skill for the user's outcome, respect its declared capability level, and validate the result using repository-native checks.
